description: This file defines a C# class CatalogItemService that implements the ICatalogItemService interface. It provides methods for creating, editing, deleting, and retrieving catalog items via HTTP calls, often aggregating data from multiple services and enriching catalog items with brand and type names.

classes.name: CatalogItemService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing catalog items, including CRUD operations and data aggregation for display purposes.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item by posting to an API endpoint.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Updates an existing catalog item via API.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item by its ID.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a catalog item by its ID, including enriching it with brand and type names.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Retrieves a paged list of catalog items, enriching each with brand and type names.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Retrieves a complete list of catalog items, enriching each with brand and type names.
